about.title: About SchemeSetu
about.heading: About SchemeSetu
about.intro: SchemeSetu helps Indian citizens find government welfare schemes they may qualify for.
about.mission: Our mission is to make scheme discovery simple, private, and accessible to everyone — including first-time internet users and people on low-end phones.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.step1: Answer a few optional questions about yourself.
howItWorks.step2: We match your answers against scheme rules — all in your browser.
howItWorks.step3: See schemes you may qualify for, with plain-language explanations.
howItWorks.step4: Apply through the official website linked on each scheme page.

dataSources.title: Data sources & methodology
dataSources.heading: Data sources & methodology
dataSources.intro: All scheme data comes from official government sources.
dataSources.methodology: Each scheme record includes the official source URL and a last-verified date. Records that have not been verified are clearly marked.
dataSources.verification: We validate all scheme data at build time. The build fails if any record is invalid.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.intro: SchemeSetu is built for privacy by design.
privacy.noStorage: We do not store, log, or transmit your answers.
privacy.noAnalytics: We do not use third-party analytics or trackers.
privacy.clientSide: Eligibility matching runs entirely in your browser.
privacy.noUrls: Your answers are never included in URLs or shared with any server.
privacy.language: Your language choice is stored in your browser's local storage. No other personal data is stored.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.heading: Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: SchemeSetu is an informational tool, not an official government website.
disclaimer.noGuarantee: We do not guarantee eligibility. Final eligibility is decided by the issuing authority.
disclaimer.notOfficial: Always verify details on the official scheme website before applying.
disclaimer.liability: We are not liable for any decisions made based on information on this site.
